title: Name, nickname, birth and birthplace
summary: Stecklet explains his nickname Bat from his French godfather uncle, and gives his birth date (1877) and birthplace in the Ninth Ward.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Yes. And what is your middle name? Is that B? B. Batiste. Batiste. And your name is Bat? Is that right? What? Do they call you Bat? Is that a nickname?
Yeah, that's a nickname, yeah. I was named that French uncle of mine, you know. He emigrated from France here. Oh, yes. And he married my mother's sister, you see.
And of course, when I came to the world, he stood Godfather for me. And consequently, he first made that, you see, John Batiste.
Was he a musician? Did he play? No, no, he was no musician. Did your father, mother, anyone play music? No, no. We didn't get your age. When is your birthday? When were you born?
Oh, yeah, on the 22nd of November, 1877. Yes. Understand?
Yes. Where were you born, Mr. Stack?
Right here in New Orleans, downtown, though, in the Ninth Ward. Ah. Does this record what I said?
Yes. We'll have it down on tape, so we'll be able to hear it then, and we can copy it down later on the paper, too. Ah.
Well, just, you can just ask me now, whatever you want to tell me, want me to ask.
